title: Context Window — Telugu + English Learning
subtitle: Diagrams, tiles, code, labels, formulas Englishలో. Questions, options, explanations modern Telugu + Englishలో.
hero:
CONTEXT WINDOW · VISUAL OVERVIEW

A window into information—not unlimited memory.

Only the tokens included in the current working context are available to the model. Longer conversations may require selection, retrieval, or summarization.

questions.stem: LLMsలో Context Window అంటే ఏమిటి? Model Response Generate చేసే సమయంలో ఎంత Text లేదా Other Tokenized Information Consider చేయగలదో ఇది ఎలా Limit చేస్తుంది?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Token windows provide limited working space

The window is a limited working space. Its maximum size is model-specific.
options: Context Window Earlier All Chatsకి Unlimited Access ఇచ్చి Everything Permanentగా Remember చేస్తుంది.
Context Window Model ఒకసారి Consider చేసే Tokenized Input Informationకి Limit Sets చేస్తుంది.
Context Window Model Response Finish అయిన తర్వాత Output Words Only Count చేస్తుంది.
Context Window Current Chat నుంచి Model Weightsని Permanently Update చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Context Window అంటే AI ఒక Requestలో Handle చేయగల Tokenized Information Limit. Large Inputకి Budget Matter అవుతుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Context Window Max Token Sequence Limit; Text, Images, Tools వంటి Multimodal Inputs Token Accounting Model-Specific. Input+Available Output Context Budgetకి Count అయ్యే Rules Provider/Architectureపై Depend.

questions.stem: Context Window, Input Tokens, Output Tokens, Model Trained Knowledge మధ్య Difference ఏమిటి? Large Window Permanent Memory ఎందుకు కాదు?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Context is different from knowledge or permanent memory

A big window isn't permanent memory. Saved information must be retrieved into context.
options: Output Tokens Automatically Permanent Stored Memory అవుతాయి; Application Settings Matter కావు.
Larger Windowతో Model Every Chatలో Learned Weights Directly Update చేస్తుంది.
Context Window Whole Internet Knowledgeని Automatically Retrieve చేసి Store చేస్తుంది.
Input Prompt; Output Reply; Trained Knowledge Model Weightsలో Separately Encoded ఉంటుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Input Tokens మన Prompt; Output Tokens Model Reply. Trained Knowledge Weightsలో ఉంటుంది; Window Permanent Memory కాదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Prompt Messages, Instructions, Retrieved Data Input Tokens; Generated Reply Output Tokens. Training Knowledge Weightsలో Separateగా Encoded. Application Memory External Storage Can Reinsert Selected Past Facts, Not Model's Automatically Permanent Memory.

questions.stem: Long Conversation Context Limitకి Close లేదా Exceed అయితే Older Messages Remove, Summarize, Truncate చేస్తే Model Answersపై ఏ Effect వస్తుంది?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Old chat details can vanish after truncation or summarization

Removing old messages can erase exact facts; summaries may omit key details.
options: Older Messages Drop లేదా Summarize అవవచ్చు; Important Details Later Missing కావచ్చు.
Context Limit Exceed అయినా Every Exact Earlier Message Model Always Recall చేస్తుంది.
Summary Every Number, Nuance, Quoteని Loss లేకుండా Perfectగా Preserve చేస్తుంది.
Window Exceed అయిన వెంటనే Every Model Forever Replies Generate చేయలేకపోతుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Conversation Too Long అయితే Earlier Messages Drop, Summarize కావచ్చు. Important Details Lost అయితే Next Answer Wrong కావచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Limit Exceed సమయంలో Application Request Reject, Old Turns Trim, Sliding Window, Summaries, Retrieval Use చేయవచ్చు. Compression Important Entities/Numbers Remove చేయవచ్చు, Therefore Grounding/Memory Design Needed.

questions.stem: Tokenization, RoPE/Positional Information, Attention కలిసి Context Windowలో Long Sequences Process చేసినప్పుడు Compute, Memory ఎందుకు Increase అవుతాయి?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Full attention becomes more expensive on longer sequences

More tokens mean more attention comparisons. Efficient kernels reduce memory overhead, not all arithmetic.
options: Tokenization One Word = One Token Guarantee; RoPE Context Length Limits Remove చేస్తుంది.
Standard Full Attentionలో Sequence Length Increase అయినా Compute Constantగా Remains ఉంటుంది.
Tokens, Positions Order Show; Longer Attention Compute, Memory Costs Increase చేస్తుంది.
RoPE All Prior Hidden Statesని One Tokenగా Compress చేసి Memory Growth Stop చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Tokens Text Pieces; Position Methods Order Capture చేస్తాయి. More Tokens ఉంటే Attention Work, Memory Need Increase అవుతాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Tokenization Variable-Length Subwords Create చేస్తుంది. RoPE Positions Q/K Rotate చేస్తుంది. Dense Full Attention Pair Interactions O(N²); Inference KV Cache O(N) per layer for Stored K/V Often Significant.

questions.stem: Large Documentsకి Chunking, RAG, Sliding Window, Summarization, Prompt Compression Techniques Context Budgetని ఎలా Manage చేస్తాయి? Trade-offs ఏమిటి?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Chunk, retrieve, slide, or summarize to manage the budget

Retrieval chooses useful passages; shortening text can discard important evidence.
options: RAG All Documents Permanently Learn చేస్తుంది; Future Retrieval Never Needed అవుతుంది.
Chunking/Retrieval Relevant Text Select; Summaries Compress కానీ Details Lose కావచ్చు.
Sliding Window First Sentenceకి Permanent Exact Recall Guarantee ఇస్తుంది.
Prompt Compression Shortened Meaning Always Perfectly Equivalentగా Preserve చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: RAG Relevant Parts Retrieve చేస్తుంది; Summaries History Short చేస్తాయి. Both Useful, కానీ Missing Details Risk ఉంటుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Chunking Documents Split చేస్తుంది; RAG Query-Relevant Chunks Retrieve; Sliding Window Recent Turns Retain; Summary Compress. Retrieval Errors, Summarization Loss, Prompt Compression Nuance Loss Evaluate చేయాలి.

questions.stem: Information Context Windowలో Fit అయినా Long Promptsలో “Lost in the Middle”, Attention Dilution, Position Limitations వల్ల Model Why Miss చేయవచ్చు?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Lost-in-the-Middle: visible information may still be missed

The model may overlook middle passages despite seeing them. The curve is illustrative.
options: Information Windowలో Fit అయితే Position ఏదైనా Model Equal Accuracyతో Answer ఇస్తుంది.
Lost-in-the-Middle అంటే Middle Tokens Model Represent చేయడం Completely Impossible.
Long Context Errors Only Short Output Token Budget వల్ల Happen అవుతాయి.
Model Middle Details Miss చేయవచ్చు; Long-Context Retrieval, Reasoning Test చేయాలి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Important Detail Promptలో ఉన్నా Model Miss కావచ్చు, Especially Middleలో. Context Size, Accuracy Same Thing కాదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Lost-in-the-Middle Position Sensitivity Certain Models/Tasksలో Observed. Long Context Within Limit అయినా Recall, Multi-Hop Reasoning, Position Generalization Uneven కావచ్చు. Position-Specific Evaluations Necessary.

questions.stem: RoPE Scaling, YaRN, Sliding/Sparse Attention, FlashAttention, Efficient KV Cacheతో Longer Context Support, Needle-in-a-Haystack, RULER Benchmarks ఎలా Evaluate చేస్తాం?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

RoPE scaling, efficient attention, KV cache, and benchmarks

Scaling positions extends reach; optimized attention and cache save resources. Test actual accuracy.
options: RoPE Scales Positions; Attention, Caching Save Costs; Benchmarks Test చేస్తాయి.
FlashAttention Every Model Context Size Automatically Unlimitedగా Extend చేస్తుంది.
Needle Test Pass అయితే Every Long-Context Reasoning Task Guaranteed Correct అవుతుంది.
Sparse Attention Every Full-Attention Connection Preserve చేసి Identical Accuracy ఇస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: RoPE Scaling Long Positions Handle చేయడానికి Help చేస్తుంది; Efficient Attention Costs Reduce చేస్తుంది. Real Benchmarksతో Accuracy Check చేయాలి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. RoPE Scaling/YaRN Position Range Extend చేయవచ్చు; Sliding/Sparse Attention Connections Restrict; FlashAttention Exact Attention Memory Traffic Optimize. Needle Tests Retrieval, RULER Various Long-Context Tasks Check; Latency, Memory Compare చేయాలి.
